# Security Policy

See [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) in the repository root for the full policy,
the threat model summary, and the operator checklist.

**To report a vulnerability:** use
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/palmate09/opencode-remote-control/security/advisories/new).
Please do not open a public issue or a public pull request for a vulnerability.

We acknowledge reports within 72 hours, assess within 14 days, and aim to fix
and disclose within 90 days, coordinated with the reporter.
